# NKK-Education Hub
> Premium academic gateways for international Mathematics and Chemistry, providing structured notes, formula guides, topical worksheets, and past paper search tools.

## Information for LLMs
- [Full Markdown Knowledge-Base](/llms-full.txt): Concatenated full text markdown of all study notes, guides, and curriculums for NKK-Education Hub.

## Core Pages
*General overview and introductory pages of the portal.*

- [AP Chemistry Prep](/chem/sat-ap.html): Chương Trình Luyện Thi Hóa Học Advanced Placement (College Board)
- [About Me & Philosophy](/about.html): Detailed course resources and past papers.
- [NKK-Education Hub](/index.html): Premium Academic Gateways for International Mathematics & Chemistry
- [Reference Books](/books.html): Thư viện Sách Tham Khảo Toán & Hóa học Quốc Tế (IB, A-Level, AP, IGCSE, SAT)
- [Test Bank Portal](/test_bank.html): Exam Preparation Resources & Question Banks for International Mathematics & Chemistry
